title: THE LUCY | Hot Tub | Views | Grill | Parking
description:
Discover the ultimate Nashville getaway in this stunning three-bedroom home at The Lucy. This property boasts a stylish design, custom features, and a private rooftop with a hot tub and grill, offering amazing skyline views. Situated near Downtown Broadway, East Nashville, and Germantown, you'll be close to the city's top destinations.

The space
★Highlights★
- Rooftop with Hot Tub + skyline views + natural gas grill
- 3 miles from downtown
- Professionally Decorated
- Fully Stocked Chef's Kitchen

*Must Climb Stairs*

Layout
★Level One★
2 Car Garage 2 (Trucks/SUVs longer than 21’6” will NOT fit in garage)
Laundry Room - Full Sized Washer + Dryer (pods and dryer sheets included)

★Level Two★
Bedroom One - King Bed, Smart TV + Full ensuite Bathroom with Walk-in Shower + Double Sinks, Room Darkening Drapes
Bedroom Two - Queen Bed, Smart TV + Room Darkening Drapes
Bedroom Three - Queen over Queen Bunkbed, Smart TV + Room Darkening Drapes
Hallway Bathroom - Full Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo

★Level Three★
Kitchen - Fully Stocked, Gourmet Kitchen w/Island Seating + Dining Table + Coffee/Tea Station
Hallway Bathroom - Full Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo
Living Room with Queen Sofa Sleeper + Smart TV

★Level Four★
Rooftop - Hot Tub! Dining Area, Soft Seating, Gas Grill

Guest access
Guests have access to entire home except locked storage closets.

Other things to note
**MUST climb stairs**
